audit_findings.title: Partial-year Viterra earnings and financing costs are paired with the full post-deal claim
audit_findings.mechanism: The partial-period owner-earnings numerator is projected against the full post-acquisition share count, while interest expense rather than debt principal enters the equity-level OE calculation.
audit_findings.evidence: The consolidated statement of income includes results attributable to Viterra from the date of Acquisition, July 2, 2025, to December 31, 2025.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter mismatch is demonstrated: 2025 contains Viterra only from July 2, whereas the 196.042 million-share denominator reflects the post-deal claim. The direction cannot be established because both Viterra earnings and acquisition financing costs are partial-year. The filed 2026 first-half net income attributable to Bunge was $746 million, but it is not a clean owner-earnings measure and cannot quantify the correction. A full-perimeter baseline could materially change the $504.8 million anchor.
audit_findings.action: Build trailing-twelve-month or full-year post-close OE using the complete perimeter, current interest structure, maintenance capex and working capital, excluding unproven synergies; rerun all scenarios and per-share values.

audit_findings.title: The $1.307 billion stakes add-on may double count affiliate value
audit_findings.magnitude: up to $1.307 billion, or $6.67 per share, equal to 14.8% of $8.805 billion base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Affiliate earnings retained in OE are capitalized in operating PV, while the $1.307 billion stakes value is separately added in the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company records its interest in the net earnings of its equity method investees, along with the amortization of basis differences, within Income (loss) from affiliates, in the consolidated statements of income.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates that affiliate income enters consolidated earnings, including $26 million in 2025 and $12 million in the first half of 2026. The record does not establish whether it was removed from the OE series, so double counting remains an unresolved possibility rather than a demonstrated error. The bridge amount is large enough to materially affect value and the buy threshold.
audit_findings.action: Produce the OE ledger for every historical year showing removal of affiliate income, distributions, associated interest and maintenance funding; reconcile the $1.307 billion bridge amount to Bunge's economic interests net of affiliate obligations, then rerun if any overlap remains.

audit_findings.title: A material disposal gain may have been capitalized as recurring owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $155 million pre-tax, equal to 30.7% of the $504.8 million anchor; after-tax effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: If retained in 2025 OE, the nonrecurring disposal gain raises the latest observation and the log-trend anchor subsequently capitalized by the DCF.
audit_findings.evidence: The transaction close resulted in a gain on sale of $ 155 million recognized in Other income - net.
audit_findings.explanation: The $155 million gain is demonstrated and arose from disposing of the North American corn-milling business. Its inclusion in OE is not established because the adjustment ledger is absent. The stated method mentions an interest-income purge but not this gain. Given its scale relative to the anchor, possible inclusion is material even though the exact after-tax correction is unavailable.
audit_findings.action: Inspect the 2025 OE ledger, remove the after-tax gain and related transaction effects if present, consistently remove earnings and maintenance needs of the disposed business, recompute the three-year log trend and rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: Positive growth may be modeled without its required reinvestment
audit_findings.magnitude: computed implied annual incremental capital of approximately $481 million at 2% growth and $1.202 billion at 5% growth if the 2.1% RONTA is used as the marginal-return proxy; filed 2026 capex guidance is $1.5-$1.7 billion
audit_findings.mechanism: Growth raises forecast OE and terminal value, but omitted incremental capex or working-capital funding would leave those cash flows overstated.
audit_findings.evidence: We intend to make capital expenditures in the range of $1.5 billion to $1.7 billion in 2026.
audit_findings.explanation: Positive growth and the 2.1% RONTA are demonstrated, but the record does not show whether forecast OE includes growth reinvestment. Applying the reported return as a proxy illustrates a capital requirement comparable to or greater than the $504.8 million anchor, making the omission reasonably capable of materially changing the base and bull valuations. The computed amounts are diagnostic, not established required spending, because marginal returns and the capex split are not filed.
audit_findings.action: Separate maintenance, compliance, productivity and growth capex; estimate incremental working capital and marginal returns by scenario; deduct the required investment from forecast OE and terminal cash flow, then rerun base and bull cases.

audit_findings.title: The full cash and short-term-investment add-back may not be distributable surplus
audit_findings.magnitude: up to $788 million, or $4.02 per share, equal to 8.9% of $8.805 billion base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Cash and short-term investments are added directly in the equity bridge even if some amount is required for inventory purchases, margin settlements, seasonal liquidity, restrictions or noncontrolling interests.
audit_findings.evidence: Generally, during periods when commodity prices are rising, our agribusiness operations require increased use of cash to support working capital to acquire inventories and fund daily settlement requirements on exchange traded futures that we use to minimize price risk related to the purchase and sale of our inventories.
audit_findings.explanation: The latest filing supports the $788 million total through $593 million of cash and $195 million of marketable securities and short-term investments. Adding the entire balance is demonstrated; treating all of it as surplus is not. Removing the full amount would reduce base value from $44.92 to about $40.90 per share and the 30%-MOS threshold from $31.44 to about $28.62, a material valuation shift even though it would reinforce the conclusion that $118.71 exceeds estimated value.
audit_findings.action: Establish minimum operating and margin liquidity from seasonal cash usage, restrictions and parent ownership; classify only the verified excess as a bridge asset and rerun all per-share values and the buy-below threshold.

audit_findings.title: Affiliate guarantees create a non-debt claim not captured by parent interest expense
audit_findings.magnitude: latest filed $15 million recorded liability and $180 million drawn exposure, with $206 million maximum potential payments; maximum equals $1.05 per share or 2.3% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: An expected affiliate-support obligation should reduce the stakes bridge if it is neither already reflected in OE nor netted from the investment value.
audit_findings.evidence: Based on the amounts drawn under guaranteed debt facilities at December 31, 2025, Bunge's potential liability was $ 213 million, and it has recorded $ 29 million of obligations related to these guarantees within Other current liabilities and Other non-current liabilities.
audit_findings.explanation: The guarantee exposure is demonstrated, but omission from stakes_net is not. At June 30, 2026, the recorded obligation had fallen to $15 million and drawn exposure to $180 million. Even deducting the entire $206 million filed maximum would reduce base value only from $44.92 to about $43.87 per share and would not change the valuation conclusion at a $118.71 market price. The recorded-liability effect alone is about $0.08 per share.
audit_findings.action: Confirm that the latest $15 million liability is captured once, update recourse and expected-loss analysis, and net any incremental probable support obligation from stakes_net; no full DCF rerun is needed unless evidence indicates exposure beyond the filed $206 million maximum.
